delivery.title: Delivery & Distribution
delivery.description: Streamline and manage your end-to-end release workflows with a single, powerful API
delivery.feature1: Create and manage releases, tracks, metadata, and rights
delivery.feature2: Automate release scheduling and version control
delivery.feature3: Deliver to DSPs using your own deals or Soncollab's deals
delivery.feature4: Monitor delivery status and DSP ingestion with webhook support

catalog.title: Catalog Management
catalog.description: Complete catalog control through API endpoints for efficient music library management
catalog.feature1: Full CRUD operations on catalog items

analytics.title: Reporting & Analytics
analytics.description: Access structured performance data via API and embed real-time insights into your workflows
analytics.feature1: Query streaming and revenue data by track, release, region, or DSP
analytics.feature2: Monitor trends in audience behavior and engagement
analytics.feature3: Export structured data or integrate directly into analytics tools
analytics.feature4: Supports CSV export and raw data sync

royalties.title: Rights, Royalties & Payments
royalties.description: Automate calculations and streamline royalty reporting with a powerful API
royalties.feature1: Define contracts with configurable terms: splits, recoupables, payout logic
royalties.feature2: Import and reconcile DSP statements with contract data
royalties.feature3: Generate audit-ready statements, invoices, and payout summaries
royalties.feature4: Full API access to royalty line items, reports, and payment status
